name: The Generation Gap
grammar: Modal verbs: must, have to, should

notes.title: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
notes.body: 1) must / have to + V nguyên mẫu: diễn tả sự cần thiết, bắt buộc ở hiện tại. Ví dụ: Oh, it's 10 p.m. I must go home now. / I have to go home now. 2) have to dùng được ở mọi thì: quá khứ had to, tương lai will have to (must KHÔNG có dạng quá khứ/tương lai). Ví dụ: My grandmother had to do all household chores. / We will have to accept these generational differences. 3) must: người nói tự thấy cần thiết; have to: bắt buộc do người khác/quy định đặt ra. Ví dụ: I must clean my room before my friend comes. / I have to clean my room every day. (My mother forces me to do it.) 4) mustn't = cấm, không được phép: You mustn't behave rudely towards other people. 5) don't/doesn't have to = không cần thiết (làm cũng được, không làm cũng được): They don't have to wear uniforms at the weekend. 6) should / shouldn't: khuyên, đề nghị, nêu ý kiến đúng/sai: I think parents should limit their children's screen time. Cấu trúc câu hỏi/phủ định của have to dùng trợ động từ do/does/did: Do you have to …? – He doesn't have to … Lỗi hay gặp: viết *must to / *musts / *will must; nhầm mustn't (cấm) với don't have to (không cần); dùng must cho việc trong quá khứ (phải dùng had to).

notes.title: Contracted forms (dạng rút gọn)
notes.body:
Trong văn nói và văn viết thân mật, trợ động từ/động từ to be/động từ khuyết thiếu thường được rút gọn và đọc nhẹ, nối vào từ đứng trước.
- 'll = will: we'll /wiːl/, I'll /aɪl/, who'll /huːl/
- 're = are: you're /jɔː(r)/
- 's = is/has: that's, what's, it's (It's 11 o'clock = It is; He's done it = He has)
- 've = have: I've done it; 'd = had/would: I'd like … (would), I'd finished … (had)
- n't = not: can't /kɑːnt/, don't /dəʊnt/, mustn't /ˈmʌsnt/ (không đọc âm /t/ giữa), doesn't, didn't
- let's = let us
Lưu ý: dạng đầy đủ (do not, I will) thường dùng khi muốn nhấn mạnh; ở câu trả lời ngắn khẳng định KHÔNG rút gọn: Yes, I will. (không nói *Yes, I'll.)

notes.title: Collocation / cụm từ cần nhớ
notes.body: generation gap; nuclear family ↔ extended family; traditional view(s); common characteristics; generational conflict; cultural values; gender roles; argue over small things; follow in sb's footsteps; force sb to do sth; express your opinion; deal with (conflict); come into conflict with sb; digital natives; critical thinkers; experiment with sth; value teamwork; point(s) of view; be open to new ways of thinking; have fixed ideas; complain about sth; limit screen time; take away electronic devices; ask for permission; adapt to a new culture; native language.

notes.title: Hỏi và cho phép (Everyday English)
notes.body:
Xin phép: (Please) Can I …? / Do you mind if I + V (hiện tại)? / Would you mind if I + V-ed (quá khứ)? / Is it OK if I …?
Cho phép: Sure. / Of course you can. / No problem. / Please feel free to …
Từ chối: I'm afraid not. / No, please don't. / I'm afraid you can't. / I'm sorry, but that's not possible.
Lưu ý: với 'Do/Would you mind if …?' muốn đồng ý thì trả lời phủ định: No, not at all. / Of course not.

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
- Thấy mốc quá khứ (yesterday, in the past, fifty years ago, when … was young) → had to; mốc tương lai (next year, tomorrow) → will have to.
- Câu có lý do 'It's against the rules / not allowed' → mustn't; 'It isn't necessary / no need' → don't have to; 'It's a good idea / I think' → should.
- Sau must/should/have to luôn là V nguyên mẫu; không có *must to, *should to.
- Viết lại câu: 'It is necessary for sb to V' = sb must/has to V; 'It isn't necessary for sb to V' = sb doesn't have to V; 'sb is not allowed to V' = sb mustn't V.
- Từ vựng: nuclear (bố mẹ + con) ≠ extended (nhiều thế hệ); 'come into conflict with', 'follow in sb's footsteps', 'experiment with' là các cụm cố định hay bị hỏi.

vocab.ex: Today, we'll talk about the generation gap.
I have to learn to accept the differences between the generations.
It's the difference in beliefs and behaviour between young and older people.
It's the difference in beliefs and behaviour between young and older people.

vocab.vi: gia đình hạt nhân (bố mẹ và con cái)
vocab.ex: I live in a nuclear family with my parents and brother.

vocab.vi: gia đình nhiều thế hệ (có ông bà, cô chú…)
vocab.ex: I live with my extended family.
We understand each other quite well though we still argue over small things.
We can't avoid daily arguments.
My grandparents hold traditional views about male jobs and gender roles.

vocab.vi: nối nghiệp, đi theo con đường của ai
vocab.ex: They never force us to follow in their footsteps.
They give us advice, but never force us to follow in their footsteps.
You must respect your parents and grandparents.
You should also express your opinion.
A traditional view is that men are the breadwinners in the family.
In many countries the following three generations have common characteristics.
When you live with your extended family, you have to deal with generational conflict.
Each generation has its cultural values that are influenced by social and economic conditions.

vocab.vi: trụ cột gia đình (người kiếm tiền chính)
vocab.ex: A traditional view is that men are the breadwinners in the family.
You have to deal with generational conflict.
When Gen Xers grew up, they experienced many social changes and developments in history.

vocab.vi: người có tư duy phản biện
vocab.ex: Gen Xers are also known as critical thinkers.
Generation Y, also known as Millennials, refers to those born between the early 1980s and late 1990s.
They are curious and ready to accept changes.

They also value teamwork.

vocab.ex: That is why Gen Zers are also called digital natives.

They think it is safer to be your own boss than relying on someone else to hire you.

vocab.w: be open to new ways of thinking
vocab.ipa: /bi ˈəʊpən tə njuː weɪz əv ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/
vocab.vi: cởi mở với cách nghĩ mới
vocab.ex: I think my parents are quite open to new ways of thinking.

vocab.vi: có suy nghĩ cố hữu, khó thay đổi
vocab.ex: Some older people have fixed ideas about the world.
Teenagers want to make their own decisions.
My parents limit the time I spend on electronic devices.
My parents complain about my clothes and hairstyle.
My parents complain about my clothes and hairstyle.

vocab.ex: Too much screen time is bad for teenagers' health.
Ask your parents for permission if you want to colour your hair.
Children of Asian American immigrants adapt to American culture much faster than their parents.
Children of Asian American immigrants adapt to American culture quickly.

passages.title: Three generations under one roof
passages.text: In many Vietnamese homes, three generations live together under one roof. Living in (1) _____ families has many advantages. Grandparents can look after young children while parents go to work, and children can learn valuable lessons from the elders. However, there are also some problems. Grandparents usually hold traditional (2) _____ about many issues, such as gender roles and careers. For example, they may think that a girl (3) _____ learn to cook and do all the housework, while a boy should become the breadwinner. Teenagers, on the other hand, want to make their own decisions and follow their dreams. As a result, they sometimes come into (4) _____ with older family members over small things like clothes or hairstyles. To reduce the generation gap, family members should listen to and respect each other's opinions. Teenagers (5) _____ be rude to their grandparents, and grandparents should try to be open to new ways of thinking.

passages.title: Kevin and his screen time
passages.text: Kevin is sixteen, and like many teenagers, he loves his smartphone and laptop. He mainly uses them (6) _____ chatting with friends and playing games. His parents, however, are worried that he spends too much time on screens. They believe that too much screen time is bad for teenagers' health because it can damage eyesight and reduce sleep time. That is why they (7) _____ his screen time to two hours a day and take away his devices after 9 p.m. Kevin thinks this rule is unfair. He says that teenagers today are digital natives, people (8) _____ grew up with technology. He also argues that the quality of screen time is more important than the quantity, because he can learn useful skills through educational videos. (9) _____, he understands that his parents only want the best for him. After a long discussion, they reached an agreement: Kevin (10) _____ ask for permission before playing games, but he can use his laptop freely for his studies.

questions.q: A _____ family consists of a father, a mother, and their children.
questions.explain: nuclear family = gia đình hạt nhân, chỉ gồm bố mẹ và con cái. extended family gồm nhiều thế hệ; large/close không mang nghĩa định nghĩa này.

questions.q: Mai lives with her _____ family, including her grandparents, her parents, and her uncle's family.
questions.explain: Gia đình có cả ông bà, bố mẹ, gia đình chú bác → extended family (gia đình nhiều thế hệ). nuclear chỉ có bố mẹ và con; single/only không phù hợp.

questions.q: In many traditional families, the father is the _____; he earns most of the money for the family.
questions.explain: breadwinner = trụ cột gia đình, người kiếm tiền chính. homemaker = người nội trợ; housekeeper = quản gia; babysitter = người trông trẻ.

questions.q: Gen Zers are often called digital _____ because they grew up online and never knew the world before social media.
questions.explain: digital natives = những người sinh ra trong thời đại công nghệ số (cụm cố định trong bài đọc). Các từ còn lại không tạo thành cụm với nghĩa này.

questions.q:
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
Millennials are <u>curious</u> and ready to accept changes.
questions.explain: curious = tò mò, muốn biết → gần nghĩa nhất với eager to know. careful = cẩn thận; worried = lo lắng; bored = chán.

questions.q:
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
Many Gen Zers want to be their own boss rather than rely on someone else to <u>hire</u> them.
questions.explain: hire = thuê, tuyển dụng = employ. dismiss = sa thải (trái nghĩa); train = đào tạo; pay = trả lương.

questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
My grandparents hold very <u>traditional</u> views about gender roles.
questions.explain: traditional (truyền thống) trái nghĩa với modern (hiện đại). conservative, old-fashioned gần nghĩa với traditional; usual = thông thường.

questions.q: My brother doesn't want to follow in our father's _____. He hopes to become a musician, not an engineer.
questions.explain: Thành ngữ follow in sb's footsteps = nối nghiệp, đi theo con đường của ai. Không dùng footprints/steps/shoes trong cụm này.

questions.q: Each generation has its own cultural _____ that are influenced by social and economic conditions.
questions.explain: cultural values = giá trị văn hoá (niềm tin về điều quan trọng trong một xã hội). prices/costs = giá cả, chi phí; rates = mức, tỉ lệ – không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: There are some _____ differences between my parents and me, but we try to understand each other.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ differences cần tính từ → generational (thuộc về thế hệ). generationally là trạng từ, generate/generating là động từ.

questions.q: We understand each other quite well, though we sometimes have _____ over small things.
questions.explain: Sau động từ have cần danh từ → arguments (những cuộc cãi vã). argue/argued là động từ, argumentative là tính từ.

questions.q: Gen Zers are very creative and are able to _____ with platforms to suit their needs.
questions.explain: experiment with sth = thử nghiệm với cái gì. experience = trải qua (không đi với with); expect = mong đợi; explore là ngoại động từ (explore platforms), không đi với with.

questions.q: When you live with your extended family, you have to deal _____ generational conflict.
questions.explain: Cụm động từ deal with = giải quyết, đối phó với. Các giới từ khác không đi với deal theo nghĩa này.

questions.q: My mother keeps _____ about my clothes and hairstyle. She thinks I should dress more neatly.
questions.explain: complain about sth = phàn nàn về. blame sb for sth, criticise sb/sth (không có about), object to sth → không dùng với about.

questions.q:
Choose the word(s) OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined part.
Some older people <u>have fixed ideas</u> about the world.
options: are open to new ways of thinking
questions.explain: have fixed ideas = có suy nghĩ cố hữu, khó thay đổi; trái nghĩa là be open to new ways of thinking (cởi mở với cách nghĩ mới). Ba phương án còn lại đều gần nghĩa.

questions.q: Kevin's parents _____ his screen time to two hours a day.
questions.explain: limit sth to + số lượng = giới hạn ở mức. prevent sb from doing; avoid doing; ban = cấm hẳn, không đi với 'to two hours'.

questions.q: Gen Xers are known as _____ thinkers because they achieved higher levels of education than previous generations.
questions.explain: Trước danh từ thinkers cần tính từ → critical (critical thinker = người có tư duy phản biện). criticise (v), criticism/critic (n).

questions.q: Children of Asian American immigrants _____ to American culture much faster than their parents.
questions.explain: adapt to = thích nghi với. adopt = nhận nuôi/áp dụng (không đi với to); accept = chấp nhận (ngoại động từ); apply to = áp dụng cho/nộp đơn – sai nghĩa.
questions.review: Lớp 11 · Unit 2 – Communication and Culture / CLIL (tr. 25)

questions.q: "Mum, can I have your _____ to go to Mai's birthday party this Saturday?"
questions.explain: permission = sự cho phép (have/ask for permission). permit (n) = giấy phép; admission = sự cho vào/nhập học; allowance = tiền trợ cấp.
questions.review: Lớp 11 · Unit 2 – Communication and Culture / CLIL (tr. 25)

questions.q: When working in a team, Millennials welcome different _____ of view and ideas from others.
questions.explain: Cụm cố định point(s) of view = quan điểm. Không nói *ways/opinions/ideas of view.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: You _____ behave rudely towards older people. It's not polite.
questions.explain: Diễn tả điều không được phép làm → mustn't. don't have to = không cần (sai nghĩa); have to/must = phải (ngược nghĩa).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Tomorrow is Sunday, so I _____ get up early. I can sleep until 9 a.m.
questions.explain: 'I can sleep until 9 a.m.' → không cần dậy sớm → don't have to. mustn't = cấm (vô lý); must/have to = phải (ngược nghĩa).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: In the past, my grandmother _____ walk five kilometres to school every day.
questions.explain: 'In the past' → quá khứ. must không có dạng quá khứ nên dùng had to. has to là hiện tại; should = lời khuyên.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: I think teenagers _____ spend less time on social media and more time with their families.
questions.explain: 'I think…' → đưa ra ý kiến/lời khuyên → should. had to sai thì; mustn't/don't have to ngược nghĩa (khuyên nên dành thêm thời gian cho gia đình).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Next year, my brother _____ wear a uniform when he starts his new job.
questions.explain: 'Next year' → tương lai. must không đứng sau will, nên dùng will have to. had to là quá khứ; must have + V3 là phỏng đoán quá khứ.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Students _____ use their phones during the exam. It's against the rules.
questions.explain: 'It's against the rules' → bị cấm → mustn't. don't have to = không cần; should/have to ngược nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: You look really tired. You _____ go to bed earlier tonight.
questions.explain: Đưa ra lời khuyên → should. mustn't/don't have to ngược ý; had to sai thì (tonight).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: I _____ clean my room every day. My mother forces me to do it.
questions.explain: Sự bắt buộc do người khác đặt ra (my mother forces me) → have to. should chỉ là lời khuyên; mustn't/don't have to ngược nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: _____ you _____ wear a uniform at your school?
questions.explain: Câu hỏi với have to dùng trợ động từ: Do you have to …? (chủ ngữ you → do). Không có *Must … to; Does không đi với you; 'Have you to…' không dùng trong tiếng Anh hiện đại.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Yesterday Lan _____ stay at home because she was ill.
questions.explain: 'Yesterday' → quá khứ → had to. must/has to/should không diễn tả bắt buộc trong quá khứ.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: He _____ to finish his project by Friday. His teacher said so.
questions.explain: Chỉ has tạo thành has to + V (bắt buộc do người khác đặt ra). must/should/can + V nguyên mẫu, không có 'to'.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: My parents respect my choices. I _____ follow in their footsteps.
questions.explain: Bố mẹ tôn trọng lựa chọn → không bắt buộc phải nối nghiệp → don't have to. mustn't = bị cấm (sai nghĩa); have to/must = phải (ngược ý).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: I _____ remember to call my grandmother tonight. It's her birthday, and I really want to wish her a happy birthday.
questions.explain: Người nói tự thấy cần thiết (I really want to…) → must. had to sai thì; mustn't/don't have to ngược nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Parents _____ compare their children to others. It can make them less confident in their abilities.
questions.explain: Lý do 'it can make them less confident' → khuyên không nên → shouldn't. should/have to/must đều mang nghĩa nên/phải làm, trái với lý do.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Did your grandparents _____ live with their parents after they got married?
questions.explain: Sau trợ động từ Did dùng động từ nguyên mẫu → have to. had to/has to đã chia; must không đi sau did.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: You _____ take an umbrella. The weather forecast says it won't rain today.
questions.explain: Trời không mưa → mang ô là không cần thiết → don't have to. mustn't = cấm (vô lý); have to/must = phải.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Children _____ respect their parents and grandparents, but they _____ also express their own opinions.
questions.explain: Vế 1: bổn phận phải kính trọng → must; vế 2: lời khuyên nên bày tỏ ý kiến → should (câu của Ms Hoa). Các cặp còn lại mâu thuẫn với nghĩa (không được kính trọng/không được bày tỏ ý kiến).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: My sister has just won a full scholarship, so my parents _____ pay her tuition fees this year.
questions.explain: Có học bổng toàn phần → bố mẹ không cần trả học phí → don't have to. have to/must/should đều trái với lý do.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: It's against the law to ride a motorbike without a helmet. You _____ ride without one.
questions.explain: 'Against the law' → bị cấm → mustn't. don't have to = không cần (sai nghĩa); should/have to ngược nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
A: Do I have to wear my school uniform to the party?
B: No, you _____. It's a casual party.
questions.explain: Trả lời ngắn cho 'Do I have to…?' với nghĩa không cần thiết → No, you don't have to. mustn't = cấm (không hợp 'It's a casual party' – tiệc thân mật, mặc gì cũng được); 'haven't to', 'aren't to' sai cấu trúc.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: accepted /əkˈseptɪd/ đọc /ɪd/ (động từ tận cùng bằng /t/). experienced /ɪkˈspɪəriənst/, influenced /ˈɪnfluənst/, forced /fɔːst/ đọc /t/ (tận cùng /s/).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: characteristic /ˌkærəktəˈrɪstɪk/ đọc /k/. chores /tʃɔːz/, children /ˈtʃɪldrən/, choice /tʃɔɪs/ đọc /tʃ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: gap /ɡæp/ đọc /ɡ/. generation /ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃn/, gender /ˈdʒendə(r)/, digital /ˈdɪdʒɪtl/ đọc /dʒ/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: teamwork /ˈtiːmwɜːk/ đọc /iː/. health /helθ/, breadwinner /ˈbredwɪnə(r)/, headache /ˈhedeɪk/ đọc /e/.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: values /ˈvæljuːz/ đọc /z/ (tận cùng nguyên âm). arguments /ˈɑːɡjumənts/, beliefs /bɪˈliːfs/, habits /ˈhæbɪts/ đọc /s/ (tận cùng /t/, /f/ vô thanh).

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: though /ðəʊ/ đọc /ð/. think /θɪŋk/, health /helθ/, thinker /ˈθɪŋkə(r)/ đọc /θ/.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: extended /ɪkˈstendɪd/ nhấn âm 2. curious /ˈkjʊəriəs/, nuclear /ˈnjuːkliə(r)/, argument /ˈɑːɡjumənt/ nhấn âm 1.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: hairstyle /ˈheəstaɪl/ nhấn âm 1 (danh từ ghép). respect /rɪˈspekt/, accept /əkˈsept/, allow /əˈlaʊ/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: permission /pəˈmɪʃn/ nhấn âm 2. critical /ˈkrɪtɪkl/, digital /ˈdɪdʒɪtl/, family /ˈfæməli/ nhấn âm 1.
questions.review: Lớp 11 · Unit 2 – Communication and Culture / CLIL (tr. 25)

questions.q: Choose the word that differs from the others in the position of primary stress.
questions.explain: generation /ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃn/ nhấn âm 3 (đuôi -tion nhấn âm ngay trước). traditional /trəˈdɪʃənl/, experiment /ɪkˈsperɪmənt/, millennial /mɪˈleniəl/ nhấn âm 2.

questions.q:
What is the full form of the contracted form in this sentence?
"They <u>don't</u> force us to follow in their footsteps."
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ They, thì hiện tại đơn → don't = do not. does not đi với ngôi 3 số ít (doesn't); did not = didn't (quá khứ).

questions.q: In which sentence does I'd mean I would?
options: I'd finished my homework before dinner.
I'd already told her about it.
I'd like to talk about the generation gap.
I'd never seen her so angry before.
questions.explain: 'd có thể là had hoặc would. Trước động từ nguyên mẫu (like) → would: I'd like = I would like. Ba câu kia 'd đứng trước V3 (finished, told, seen) → had (quá khứ hoàn thành).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
My grandmother <u>must</u> (A) stay at home and <u>do</u> (B) all the housework <u>when</u> (C) she <u>was</u> (D) young.
questions.explain: Đáp án A: hành động trong quá khứ (when she was young), must không có dạng quá khứ → sửa must thành had to.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>Because</u> (A) it is against the rules, you <u>don't have to</u> (B) use your phone <u>during</u> (C) the <u>exam</u> (D).
questions.explain: Đáp án B: trái quy định → bị cấm, phải dùng mustn't thay cho don't have to (không cần).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Tomorrow <u>is</u> (A) Sunday, so I <u>don't</u> (B) have <u>get</u> (C) up <u>early</u> (D).
questions.explain: Đáp án C: cấu trúc have to + V → sửa get thành to get (I don't have to get up early).

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
I think parents <u>should</u> (A) <u>listen</u> (B) to their children instead <u>of</u> (C) <u>to force</u> (D) them to follow in their footsteps.
questions.explain: Đáp án D: sau giới từ instead of dùng V-ing → sửa to force thành forcing.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Mark <u>live</u> (A) in a nuclear family <u>with</u> (B) his parents <u>and</u> (C) his younger <u>brother</u> (D).
questions.explain: Đáp án A: chủ ngữ ngôi 3 số ít (Mark), thì hiện tại đơn → sửa live thành lives.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
<u>Next year</u> (A), my sister will <u>must</u> (B) wear a uniform <u>when</u> (C) she <u>starts</u> (D) her new job.
questions.explain: Đáp án B: must không đứng sau will; nói về bắt buộc trong tương lai dùng will have to → sửa must thành have to.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Gen Zers are <u>very</u> (A) <u>creative</u> (B) and able to experiment <u>for</u> (C) platforms to suit <u>their</u> (D) needs.
questions.explain: Đáp án C: cụm đúng là experiment with sth (thử nghiệm với) → sửa for thành with.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Gen Xers are known as critical <u>thinkers</u> (A) because they <u>achieved</u> (B) <u>higher</u> (C) levels of education than <u>previously</u> (D) generations.
questions.explain: Đáp án D: trước danh từ generations cần tính từ → sửa trạng từ previously thành previous.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It isn't necessary for you to wear a uniform at the weekend.
options: You mustn't wear a uniform at the weekend.
You don't have to wear a uniform at the weekend.
You must wear a uniform at the weekend.
You should wear a uniform at the weekend.
questions.explain: 'It isn't necessary for sb to V' = sb doesn't/don't have to V (không cần). mustn't = bị cấm; must/should = phải/nên → sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It's a good idea for parents to listen to their children's opinions.
options: Parents mustn't listen to their children's opinions.
Parents had to listen to their children's opinions.
Parents should listen to their children's opinions.
Parents don't have to listen to their children's opinions.
questions.explain: 'It's a good idea for sb to V' = lời khuyên → sb should V. mustn't/don't have to ngược nghĩa; had to sai thì và sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Students are not allowed to use their phones in class.
options: Students mustn't use their phones in class.
Students don't have to use their phones in class.
Students should use their phones in class.
Students have to use their phones in class.
questions.explain: 'be not allowed to V' (không được phép) = mustn't V. don't have to = không cần; should/have to = nên/phải → sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It was necessary for my grandmother to do all the housework.
options: My grandmother must do all the housework.
My grandmother didn't have to do all the housework.
My grandmother shouldn't do all the housework.
My grandmother had to do all the housework.
questions.explain: Câu gốc ở quá khứ (was necessary) → had to. must là hiện tại; didn't have to và shouldn't ngược nghĩa.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
My parents don't force me to follow in their footsteps.
options: I mustn't follow in my parents' footsteps.
I don't have to follow in my parents' footsteps.
I have to follow in my parents' footsteps.
My parents make me follow in their footsteps.
questions.explain: Bố mẹ không ép buộc → không bắt buộc phải nối nghiệp → I don't have to…. mustn't = bị cấm (sai); have to và make me… mang nghĩa bị ép (ngược nghĩa).

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It's not a good idea for teenagers to spend too much time on screens.
options: Teenagers don't have to spend too much time on screens.
Teenagers must spend too much time on screens.
Teenagers shouldn't spend too much time on screens.
Teenagers had to spend too much time on screens.
questions.explain: 'It's not a good idea for sb to V' = khuyên không nên → shouldn't. don't have to = không cần (không phải lời khuyên); must/had to sai nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
My grandparents live with us. They hold very traditional views.
options: My grandparents, which live with us, hold very traditional views.
My grandparents who they live with us hold very traditional views.
My grandparents, who live with us, hold very traditional views.
My grandparents, whose live with us, hold very traditional views.
questions.explain: Thay chủ ngữ chỉ người 'They' bằng đại từ quan hệ who; có dấu phẩy vì 'my grandparents' đã xác định. which dùng cho vật; 'who they' thừa chủ ngữ; whose phải đi kèm danh từ.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Kevin spends too much time on his laptop. His parents limit his screen time.
options: Although Kevin spends too much time on his laptop, his parents limit his screen time.
Kevin spends too much time on his laptop because his parents limit his screen time.
Unless Kevin spends too much time on his laptop, his parents limit his screen time.
Because Kevin spends too much time on his laptop, his parents limit his screen time.
questions.explain: Câu 1 là nguyên nhân, câu 2 là kết quả → Because …, …. Although (tương phản) và Unless (trừ khi) sai logic; câu dùng 'because' ở vế sau đảo ngược nguyên nhân – kết quả.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Mai wants to colour her hair. Her mother doesn't allow her to do it.
options: Mai wants to colour her hair, but her mother doesn't allow her to do it.
Mai wants to colour her hair because her mother doesn't allow her to do it.
Mai's mother allows her to colour her hair, but she doesn't want to.
Mai doesn't want to colour her hair, and her mother doesn't allow her to.
questions.explain: Hai ý tương phản (muốn – không được phép) → nối bằng but. 'because' sai quan hệ nguyên nhân; hai phương án còn lại sai nghĩa câu gốc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Many Gen Zers saw people lose their jobs. They want to start their own businesses.
options: Although many Gen Zers saw people lose their jobs, they want to start their own businesses.
As many Gen Zers saw people lose their jobs, they want to start their own businesses.
Many Gen Zers saw people lose their jobs, but they want to start their own businesses.
If many Gen Zers saw people lose their jobs, they wouldn't want to start their own businesses.
questions.explain: Câu 1 là lý do của câu 2 (bài đọc: thấy nhiều người mất việc nên muốn tự làm chủ) → As (= because). Although/but diễn tả tương phản; câu điều kiện loại 2 làm sai nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: Ba thế hệ cùng sống → extended families (gia đình nhiều thế hệ). nuclear chỉ gồm bố mẹ và con nên mâu thuẫn với 'three generations'; single, only không tạo nghĩa phù hợp.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (2).
questions.explain: Collocation hold traditional views = giữ quan điểm truyền thống. sights/looks/scenes không mang nghĩa 'quan điểm'.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (3).
questions.explain: Chủ ngữ 'a girl' (ngôi 3 số ít), hiện tại → has to + V. *must to sai cấu trúc; have to không chia; having to sai dạng.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (4).
questions.explain: Cụm cố định come into conflict with sb = xảy ra xung đột với ai. Không nói *come into argument/fight/quarrel.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (5).
questions.explain: Hỗn láo với ông bà là điều không được phép → mustn't. don't have to = không cần (sai nghĩa); 'needn't to', 'haven't to' sai cấu trúc.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (6).
questions.explain: use sth for + V-ing/N = dùng cái gì để làm gì. Các giới từ còn lại không đi với use theo nghĩa mục đích.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (7).
questions.explain: limit sth to + mức = giới hạn ở mức (two hours a day). prevent/stop sb from doing; avoid doing – không đi với 'to two hours'.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (8).
questions.explain: Đại từ quan hệ thay cho 'people' và làm chủ ngữ của 'grew up' → who. which dùng cho vật; whose + danh từ; whom làm tân ngữ.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (9).
questions.explain: Câu trước Kevin phản đối, câu sau cậu vẫn hiểu bố mẹ → quan hệ tương phản → However. Therefore (vì vậy), Moreover (hơn nữa) sai logic; Because không đứng một mình kèm dấu phẩy.

questions.topic: Modal verbs: must, have to, should
questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: Thoả thuận đặt ra nghĩa vụ ở hiện tại: Kevin phải xin phép trước khi chơi game, đối lập với 'can use his laptop freely' → has to. doesn't have to/mustn't sai nghĩa; had to sai thì.
